name: Nova-Life: Amboise Dedicated Server
description: Install the Nova-Life: Amboise dedicated server through SteamCMD and launch its native Linux server directly.
known_limitations: The upstream Egg does not document a graceful stop command, so stop uses the bounded terminate fallback.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: Name passed to Nova-Life when starting the dedicated server.

requirements.description: The reviewed Pelican launch targets the native Linux server.
Managed anonymous SteamCMD installation is required.

help.summary: GameNode installs Steam App 1665030 anonymously and launches nova-life.x86_64 directly.

findings.summary: Only the process-level server name is exposed; advanced configuration remains file-managed.

prerequisites: Network access to Steam content servers
